    A ML Researcher interested in RL, Robotics and Entrepreneurship

    Currently a PhD student at the Autonomous Manufacturing Lab, part of the UCL Robotics Institute, researching robotics for construction. Previously, I worked at the Alan Turing Institute on developing more resilient and robust multi-UAV systems for dynamic and uncertain environments.

    Publications

    • On‑board Mission Replanning for Adaptive Cooperative Multi‑Robot Systems (paper)
      • First Author. Accepted at IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters.
    • Entropy‑Driven Adaptive Filtering for High‑Accuracy and Resource‑Efficient FPGA‑Based Neural Network Systems (paper)
      • First Author. Published at MDPI Advanced AI Hardware Designs.
    • Efficient SAR Vessel Detection for FPGA-Based On-Satellite Sensing (preprint)
      • Third Author. Submitted to ACM/IEEE Symposium on Edge Computing. Mainly contributed to developing the PL decoding kernel.
